# @tansy/lms

Turns tansy into a learning platform: courses, lessons, enrollments, progress, quizzes and certificates.

```bash
npm install @tansy/lms
```

Add it to `tansy.config.ts`. See [the lms plugin documentation](https://github.com/mhmdsalahsebai/tansy/blob/main/docs/plugins/lms.md) for what it adds and the options it takes.

A first-party plugin for [tansy](https://github.com/mhmdsalahsebai/tansy), a self-hosted, runtime-schema CMS for Next.js. MIT licensed.
